(b) The separate, commonly-discussed 'circularity credit': stainless steel's high end-of-life recycling rate (India: material substantially recovered back into scrap streams, often cited >85-90% recovery for structural stainless) means a large share of the virgin-route carbon burden is avoided in the NEXT product life cycle — but this avoided-emissions claim is accounted for as a benefit to whichever future product uses that recycled scrap (i.e., it shows up as the low-carbon 'y' scrap-route coefficients used throughout the main grid), not as a credit within this product's own Category 12.
